summary: Stop re-offering a delivered storage credential, report the mount helper's message when a remote mount fails, and derive NFS/SMB capabilities.shared and eligible_host_ids from verified member access.

guide.reason: No operator step changes; the shared badge and error text now match the documented behaviour.

api.reason: GET /api/v1/storage capabilities.shared and eligible_host_ids now follow verified member access for NFS and SMB; the fields and schema are unchanged.

state.reason: A fresh Controller reads the same values from the pool master's storage inventory.
